A_general.open_code_note: No official public repository or package was found in the prepared evidence.

B_access_pricing.mcp_access_cost_details: The official page says connection is free and requires no API key. No MCP-specific call limits or paid tiers were found.
B_access_pricing.linked_software_cost: No official pricing page for the software exposed through this MCP was found. The endpoint provides accommodation search and price comparison; bookings link to accommodation providers.
B_access_pricing.pricing_model_details: The official MCP page states “free, no API key”; it does not specify quotas, per-call charges, or plan requirements.
B_access_pricing.other_access_restrictions: The official page describes no API key or configuration requirement. Other restrictions were not found.

C_capabilities.description_what_how: The official page lists three accommodation-search and price-trend tools. Their names and descriptions are in actions.json. A landing-page example instead shows `search_hotels`, which is not one of the listed tools.
C_capabilities.post_interaction_context_structure: Official descriptions say live accommodation results include prices, ratings, amenities, and property links; the radius tool returns the same filterable results as destination search. Price trends return monthly average, minimum, and maximum rates by star rating. Exact response schema and error structure are not published.

The supplied POST to the endpoint returned HTTP 400 with no WWW-Authenticate header provided. No authorization server, registration endpoint, grant types, PKCE, token methods, scopes, lifetime, or revocation details were found.

D_server_side_logic.additional_logic: 1. The official descriptions characterize the three listed tools as search and forecasting; Stackduke labels all three read-only. No official tool annotations (`readOnlyHint`, `destructiveHint`, `idempotentHint`, `openWorldHint`) are published. 2. No server-enforced confirmation mechanism is documented; the listed actions are searches/forecasts. 3. OAuth metadata was unavailable (see Authorization); official materials say no API key and no sign-in required. Inheritance of product roles, allowlists, token lifetime, and revocation are Unknown. 4. One global URL is listed; no read-only modes, toolset filters, or sandbox/region variants were found. 5. The general privacy notice discusses personal and usage data across trivago services; MCP-specific masking or scope boundaries are Unknown. 6. MCP quotas, rate limits, result caps, truncation, and per-call costs are not documented. 7. Input schemas and validation/correction behavior are not published. 8. MCP-specific logging, audit, and telemetry are not documented; the general privacy notice describes service usage data collection. 9. No feedback, rating, survey, or report tool appears in the official list. The result links direct users to booking providers; no MCP upsell message was found. 10. No server-delivered skills or behavioral rules are documented. The tool descriptions guide when to use destination versus coordinate search and distinguish forecasting from live availability. 11. Memory or persistent state is not documented. 12. The official materials show a single endpoint and flat list of three tools; no subservers or nested agents are documented. 13. No raw API, SQL, script, or general-purpose escape-hatch tool is listed.
behavioural_instructions_to_ai_verbatim: Use for destination- or place-name-based lodging search.
Use when the user anchors their search to a place rather than a named destination (e.g. "near the stadium," "within walking distance of X").
Use for planning questions like "when is the cheapest month to visit X" or "how do prices change through the year" — this is a forecasting tool, not a live-availability search.
D_server_side_logic.server_structure_explanation: One documented endpoint with a flat official list of three tools.

E_aggregated.action_count_comment: The official tool list at https://mcp.trivago.com/docs names three tools and gives no numeric total beyond “Three tools.” No official input schemas are published. The Claude connector directory, Stackduke, and MCP.so each list the same three names. ToolJunction and Apigene additionally list `trivago-search-suggestions`; this is included as third-party only and is not confirmed by the official list. The landing-page example names `search_hotels`, which differs from the official tool names and is not counted as an additional action. MCPbeat returned HTTP 403; the registry search showed no usable Trivago tool list.

actions.description: Search live hotel listings by destination or place name with dates, guest configuration, and filters.
Search filterable live accommodation listings near specified coordinates.
Forecast monthly average, minimum, and maximum hotel prices by star rating across a date window.
Provide search suggestions based on a query.

E_aggregated.token_method: No public code or verbatim tool definitions with schemas and initialize instructions were found; official page descriptions alone do not provide the complete pre-interaction context.
E_aggregated.human_can_agent_cannot: Humans can complete bookings with accommodation providers through links in trivago results; the official MCP list exposes search and price-trend tools but no booking or reservation action. The vendor states it does not provide or control hotel products; booking contracts are with providers. https://mcp.trivago.com/docs ; https://book.trivago.com/terms-and-conditions

F_documentation.implementation_hints_not_enforced: The tool descriptions advise agents which search to use for destinations, coordinates, or planning. No public implementation is available to determine whether these recommendations are enforced.
F_documentation.governance_promises: The general privacy notice says trivago may collect search inputs, usage data, and chatbot interaction data when users interact with its services. It does not state MCP-specific collection, retention, training, or opt-out terms.
F_documentation.promises_to_user: The official page promises live hotel prices from multiple booking sites and describes connection as free with no API key or configuration. The privacy notice is general service documentation, not an MCP-specific promise.
F_documentation.comparison_with_server_logic: The live-price, no-key, and no-configuration claims are documented on the official MCP page. With no public code and limited endpoint metadata, server-side enforcement, retention, and data-handling behavior cannot be compared. The general privacy notice does not establish MCP-specific data practices.

contradictions: The official page lists `trivago-accommodation-search`, `trivago-accommodation-radius-search`, and `trivago-destination-price-trends`, but its illustrated MCP call uses `trivago.search_hotels` / `search_hotels`; the example name does not match the listed tool names.
ToolJunction and Apigene list `trivago-search-suggestions`, while the official tool list and the three-tool listings on Claude, Stackduke, and MCP.so do not.

MCP.so describes the endpoint as OAuth and says a browser sign-in is required, while the official page says no API keys and Claude’s connector listing says sign-in is not required. The supplied endpoint probe and OAuth metadata responses do not confirm OAuth: POST returned HTTP 400 and the supplied well-known documents returned HTTP 404.
observations_for_research: The official descriptions distinguish destination-name search, coordinate-radius search, and monthly price forecasting, with explicit guidance on when an agent should use each.
The official page frames the output as comparison data plus links to third-party booking providers; no booking action is listed.
notes: Checked the prepared links.json, links_check.txt, pages/INDEX.txt, official page text and HTML, available script extracts, and the code directory; no official repository or package was present. Official tool names and descriptions are published, but schemas, annotations, initialize instructions, protocol version, and server implementation were not found. Third-party catalogue evidence is used only for the additional search-suggestions name and cross-checking. Unofficial community entries found in the prepared links were excluded.
